Where the A7 Sportback feels most at home is, unsurprisingly, eating up the kilometres as a long-distance tourer.
It rewards with a nice, quiet and calming ambience free of much in the way of noise penetration as a trade for not possessing much of a muscular vibe.

After a cursory steer, I'm inclined to believe Audi has indeed delivered on its claims of high-brow design, luxury, tech and driving fun - or perhaps, more accurately, satisfaction - with the new A7 Sportback.
Although, I can say the Active Lane Keep, like most other applications on the market, fails to be anything other than a hindrance along a mountain road.
